hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Start at each grid cell and traverse continuously in all 8 directions to build numbers strictly greater than 10.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Test primality of each generated number using trial division up to sqrt(x).

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Count prime frequencies with a hash map and return the most frequent, breaking ties by choosing the maximum prime.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: 8-directional ray casting from each cell with primality testing.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Grid dimensions are tiny (m, n <= 6), making ray simulation optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(P) auxiliary memory for prime frequency map.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Notice that only numbers > 10 should be evaluated for primality.
